prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 11 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean, simple line drawing: uniform thin black outlines on a plain white background, with no shading, hatching, grey tones, colour or texture. Each panel has a thin black border, with plain white gutters between the panels. Location: 灵堂, Day, cool daylight through the tall left windows and a flat fluorescent wash.
Image 1: the character sheet of 司念 (18), look S0
Image 2: the character sheet of 司辛 (50)
Image 3: the character sheet of 张翠梅 (55)
Image 4: the location 灵堂, with no people
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image: the hairstyle, build and outfit in outline. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location image only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location image, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Funeral hall, same axis, camera on the window side, the bier at screen right. Si Nian sits upright on the bier in burial clothes, the white cloth at her waist, eyes half shut, frowning. Zhang Cuimei sits on the floor in the front row where she fell, and Si Xin stands half a step back at her side, both facing the bier. Unnamed mourners and Si Yi have fled toward the walls. Paper wreaths line both walls and the one pair of double wooden doors is at screen left.
Panel 1: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level from the window side. Si Nian rubs her eyes with one hand and pats the white cloth beside her, searching for something.
Panel 2: Wide shot, low angle from the window side, bier at screen right. Si Nian swings her legs off the bier and stands beside it in her burial clothes.
Panel 3: Close-up, fast push in on her face, eye-level. Si Nian's eyes snap fully open and her mouth falls open in shock as she takes in the hall.
Panel 4: Medium close-up, handheld, eye-level from the window side. Si Xin points a trembling finger at her, backing away, his glasses crooked.
Panel 5: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level from the window side. Si Nian looks Si Xin up and down, staring at his grey suit and armband, and points at him.
Panel 6: Close-up, low angle from the window side. Si Xin swallows hard and takes another step back, clutching his jacket front.
Panel 7: Wide shot, high angle, pan following Si Nian toward screen left. Si Nian walks along the paper wreaths toward the mourners, peering around and fingering a white ribbon.
Panel 8: Medium shot, high angle from the window side. Zhang Cuimei scoots backward on the floor on her hands, one hand raised to ward Si Nian off.
Panel 9: Close-up, rack focus: the focus shifts from the paper flowers in the foreground to Si Nian's face. Si Nian leans close to a paper wreath on its stand and studies its white ribbon.
Panel 10: Extreme close-up on her eyes, locked-off camera, eye-level. Si Nian's eyes widen in disbelief.
Panel 11: Wide shot, eye-level from the window side, track following Si Nian to the doors at screen left. Si Nian strides in her burial clothes past Si Xin and Zhang Cuimei to the double wooden doors and yanks one open, and daylight floods in as the two turn to stare.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering, shading or colour.
